purpose: Teach: なべ/飼う/ちいさな/どら/通行人/お札/車道/絨毯

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、家庭科の調理実習で、本気で、絶対、なべ料理、絶対、やったよね
lines.en: Riku — you seriously made nabe in home-ec cooking class, didn't you.
lines.style: Bright, teasing energy. Leans forward with genuine curiosity. Quick, playful delivery. Light challenge wrapped in warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。俺、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんち、絶対、犬を、絶対、飼う、絶対、お手伝い、絶対、してるんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. I'm seriously helping out at Grandpa's place all the time — taking care of the dog, you know.
lines.style: Warm, animated. Slight pride underneath. Casual rhythm, like he's sharing something he likes. Eye contact easy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、ちいさな、絶対、メモ、絶対、いつも、絶対、持ってるよね、リク
lines.en: You seriously always carry around those tiny little notebooks, don't you, Riku.
lines.style: Observant, slightly amused. Gentle tease — not judgmental. Curiosity about why he does this. Soft, warm delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: コンビニの、本気で、絶対、どら焼き、絶対、安くて、絶対、美味いんだぜ、桜
lines.en: The convenience store dorayaki are seriously cheap and delicious, Sakura.
lines.style: Animated, defending something small he likes. Quick, earnest. Like he's thought about this. Not over-serious, but genuine.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 駅前、本気で、絶対、通行人、絶対、いつも、絶対、多いよね、リク
lines.en: The station front is always packed with people, seriously.
lines.style: Reflective, noticing something ordinary. Quieter tempo. Like she's thinking out loud. Slight observation, not alarm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お小遣いの、本気で、絶対、お札、絶対、お母さんから、絶対、もらったぜ、桜
lines.en: I seriously got some cash from Mom for my allowance.
lines.style: Casual, matter-of-fact. Light, unburdened delivery. Not bragging, just stating something small that happened.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、車道、絶対、渡る時、絶対、ちゃんと、絶対、確認してよね、リク
lines.en: You seriously need to look both ways when you're crossing the road, okay Riku.
lines.style: Shifts to care underneath the words. Quiet firmness — not scolding, protecting. Drops the teasing edge. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、和室の、絶対、絨毯、絶対、ふわふわで、絶対、気持ちいいぜ、桜
lines.en: Grandma's place has these seriously fluffy carpets in the Japanese room — they feel amazing, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm, content. Soft nostalgia for a small comfort. Relaxed pace. Like he's remembering something that makes him smile.
